cognium_conformis.latest_main_difference: This is the 2026-10-13 run's revision, chosen to reproduce that run. Main was `7fa92329`, 733 commits later, on 2026-11-02; it is measured in `2026-11-02-rerun-v0.1.0-latest-browser-served-conformis-main`.

rerun.title: Accessibility benchmark re-run: latest browser-served lane from committed inputs
rerun.purpose: This bundle repeats the 2026-10-13 latest-browser-served lane with every tool, case list, subject declaration and mapping taken from a commit, at the same product versions and corpus revision, to test whether that result can be repeated from committed inputs. Nu Html Checker, a markup-signal lane outside the criterion metrics, was not repeated.
rerun.comparison_note: All seven configurations give the same lane metrics as on 2026-10-13. Six give the same outcome on every one of the 214 cases. Cognium Conformis differs on two cases, listed below; neither changes a metric. Below the case level, one QualWeb native finding differs: on `static-anim_no_reduced_motion` the contrast rule `act-rules:QW-ACT-R37` (1.4.3, not the declared 2.2.2) fired in this run and not on 2026-10-13; that cell was `o` in both runs.

difference_notes.cognium: On both live-caption pages the keyboard-trap control `AX-08/2.1.2` reported a deviation under 2.1.2, which neither page declares, so each cell moves from `.` to `o` and no metric changes. The same control reported the same deviation on `media-video_no_captions` in both runs. The browser build differs between the runs (Chromium 153.0.8010.12 here, 149.0.7827.0 on 2026-10-13), and how Chromium exposes a media element to keyboard focus is a plausible source; this run does not isolate it.

reference_scorer.note: The reference scorer of the pinned corpus revision (`check/score.mjs` at `469486a4`, policy `cognium-a11y-scoring/1.0.0`, `--strict`), applied to each product's `result.json` in this bundle. Recall counts the 18 known-defect assertions outside this lane as not run; false positives are assertion-level, over the 192 `must_not_report` assertions of the 104 corrected controls. The 2026-10-13 bundle's result files give the same figures.

environment_differences: Linux on x86_64 with 2 vCPUs for every tool. On 2026-10-13 the direct tools ran on macOS/arm64 and Cognium Conformis on Linux/arm64.

Chromium 153.0.8010.12 for every tool, against 149.0.7827.55 (direct tools) and 149.0.7827.0 (Conformis). The 2026-10-13 builds could not be installed: browser downloads and the image registry were unreachable from the run host.
Node.js v22.23.4, against v25.9.0 for the direct tools.

Cognium Conformis browser passes ran in place through a local stand-in for `docker`, not in the pinned Playwright image: same mounts, same declared environment, no network where the pass declares none; the host's Chromium and fonts instead of the image's. See method.md.
Host fonts (Conformis records `sans-serif` as Inter) instead of the macOS and image font sets.
IBM rules served from the package lock on 127.0.0.1 instead of a CDN; the archive label on every page matches 2026-10-13.
The direct tools and the Conformis scan ran concurrently on the same CPUs.
limits: This run reproduces counts and case outcomes under a different OS, CPU architecture, browser build and font set. It does not show those factors have no effect on other corpora or other product versions.
Nu Html Checker was not executed. It is outside the criterion metrics.
No flows or state drivers were declared, as on 2026-10-13: the lane measures loaded entry pages.
The Cognium Conformis column depends on a private runtime. The other six columns can be repeated from public inputs alone.
